# Basalt columns: five 6-sided prisms of different heights, tops tilted a little, one glowing seam.
# Up Z, the cluster about 1.2 m across and 1.8 m tall.
new
material new Rock --base-color 0.020 0.122 0.224 --no-slot
material new Crack --base-color 0.773 0.227 0.616 --emission 0.773 0.227 0.616 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name C0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.26 --depth 1.8 --location 0 0 0.9
add mesh cylinder --name C1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.26 --depth 1.3 --location 0.45 0.05 0.65
add mesh cylinder --name C2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.24 --depth 1.0 --location -0.42 0.12 0.5
add mesh cylinder --name C3 --vertices 6 --radius 0.24 --depth 0.7 --location 0.1 -0.42 0.35
add mesh cylinder --name C4 --vertices 6 --radius 0.22 --depth 1.5 --location -0.12 0.44 0.75
select C0 C1 C2 C3 C4
material assign Rock
active C3
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Crack
mode object
active C0
join
apply --location
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
randomize --amount 0.05 --seed 2
mode object
shade flat
export basalt.glb
